The codes that govern every As-Built Engineering engagement.

As-Built Engineering runs the international standards stack with country-native regulatory overlays applied per jurisdiction.

P&ID
ISA S5.1 + ISO 10628

Instrumentation symbols + identification per ISA S5.1. Diagram for process plants per ISO 10628. Industry-standard P&ID workflow.

Isometric Piping
ISO 6428 + ASME Y14.5

Technical drawings for piping isometrics per ISO 6428. Dimensioning + tolerancing per ASME Y14.5. SmartPlant / AutoCAD Plant 3D workflow.

Single-Line Diagrams
IEEE Std 315 + IEC 60617

Graphic symbols for electrical and electronics diagrams per IEEE Std 315. IEC 60617 for international hand-over. Single-line + power distribution diagrams.

General Arrangement
ISO 128 + ISO 5455

General principles of presentation per ISO 128. Drawing scales per ISO 5455. Plant layout + equipment arrangement workflow.

Documentation Format
Native AutoCAD + SmartPlant + MicroStation

Native CAD workflow. AutoCAD .dwg primary deliverable. SmartPlant for refinery / petrochem. MicroStation for legacy ENPC engineering hand-overs.

Sign-Off
CEng MIE + CAD Lead

Chartered Engineer signature on drawing technical accuracy. CAD Lead sign-off on standards compliance + drawing-set completeness.

As-Built Engineering deliverables. Productized.

The As-Built Engineering discipline broken into distinct deliverables. Productized for repeatability across 21-country footprint.

Drawing 01

P&ID (Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams)

ISA S5.1 + ISO 10628 P&ID creation from LiDAR scan + existing reference. Process equipment + instrumentation + piping + control loops. Native AutoCAD .dwg deliverable.

Drawing 02

Isometric Piping Drawings

ISO 6428 + ASME Y14.5 isometric piping drawings. Spool sheets for fabrication. Material take-off + bill of materials. SmartPlant / AutoCAD Plant 3D workflow.

Drawing 03

Single-Line Diagrams (Electrical SLD)

IEEE Std 315 + IEC 60617 electrical single-line diagrams. Power distribution from incoming HV through LV distribution. Cross-walked with PSS load flow study deliverable.

Drawing 04

General Arrangement / Plant Layout

ISO 128 + ISO 5455 general arrangement + plant layout drawings. Equipment positioning. Piping routing. Walkway + access. Hazardous-area boundaries marked.

Drawing 05

Full Plant Documentation Package

All 4 drawing types as one bundle. Native digital twin handover. Recommended for greenfield + brownfield major retrofit. Single Principal Reviewer signature across the full set.

Common questions about As-Built Engineering.

How does LiDAR-powered As-Built differ from traditional As-Built?

Traditional As-Built relies on field measurement + sketch + redraw, which introduces 5-15% dimensional error and takes 3-5x longer. LiDAR-powered As-Built starts from a survey-grade point cloud (1.9 mm @ 10 m), then drawings are extracted within Cyclone + AutoCAD / SmartPlant. Faster, more accurate, with permanent baseline preserved.

Which CAD platforms do you deliver in?

Native AutoCAD .dwg as primary deliverable. SmartPlant for refinery + petrochem workflows. MicroStation for legacy ENPC hand-overs. Custom format on request. All drawing sets structured for native digital twin platform ingestion.

How long does a typical As-Built engagement take?

Single P&ID drawing: 1-2 days from registered point cloud. Plant-wide P&ID + Iso package: 8-16 weeks. Full plant documentation rebuild (P&ID + Iso + SLD + GA): 16-32 weeks. Joint scoping within 72 hours.

Do you bundle As-Built with LiDAR capture?

Yes. Most-common bundle. LiDAR + As-Built single-engagement pricing on request. Continuous CEng + CAD Lead oversight from field capture through drawing-set sign-off. Single Principal Reviewer signature.

How does As-Built handover to digital twin work?

Drawing-set structured for native digital twin platform ingestion. Tag-asset hierarchy mapped to digital twin object model. P&ID → process flow object. SLD → power distribution object. GA → spatial reference. Continuous synchronisation supported.
